queryType.description: SELECT to read, UPDATE to change the data, CLARIFY to ask the user first.

sparql.description: The SPARQL query or update, with its PREFIX declarations. Empty string for CLARIFY.

explanation.description: Short explanation for the user, in the language of the question. For CLARIFY, the question to ask.

newEntities.description: One entry per <urn:fieldarchive:new:N> placeholder used in the query.

typeIri.description: Full IRI of the new entity's class.

name.description: The rico:name given to the new entity, or an empty string.

targetEntityIri.description: The main entity created or edited (an existing IRI or a placeholder), or an empty string.

clarifyKind.description: For CLARIFY: ENTITY (which entity) or ENCODING (how to record the information). NONE otherwise.

candidateIris.description: For an ENTITY clarify: the IRIs of the candidate entities, found with search_entities. Empty otherwise.

encodingOptions.description: For an ENCODING clarify: the possible ways of recording the information. Empty otherwise.

exampleTriple.description: The option shown on the entity, e.g. <Jean Dupond> rico:hasOrHadDemographicGroup <masculine>.

statement.description: The decision in one sentence, to be followed if the user picks this option.
